correctness.rationale: The recent proof derives its two crucial defect identities by cancelling scalar factors 3 and 2. The defining-identity theorem for binary Zinbiel algebras is valid in characteristic different from 2, so the defect is alternating there. Hence the complete defect/spanning/minimal-ideal framework applies in every characteristic different from 2 and 3. Towers supplies the only external nilpotency input for ordinary finite-dimensional Zinbiel algebras over arbitrary fields. The dimension induction gives A^{n+1}=0, and the published normal form has factor degrees only 1 and 3, giving the arbitrary-parenthesization cutoff 3n+1.
